dct_title_s: Papua New Guinea Earthquake: Damage Proxy Maps, Sep 2022
dct_description_sm: # Papua New Guinea Earthquake: Damage Proxy Maps, Sep 2022 The **Earth Observatory of Singapore – Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS)** produced these damage proxy maps for Papua New Guinea Earthquake (Sep 2022) from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images. Each map is a separate ZIP below with its GeoTIFF, a KMZ for Google Earth, the PNG figures and a text file describing how it was made and how to read it. ## Maps in this dataset - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Papua New Guinea, Earthquake, 13 Sep 2022, v0.8** - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Papua New Guinea, Earthquake, 13 Sep 2022, v0.8** **More map details and files:** **More map details and files:** **Credits:** Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS), Advanced Rapid Imaging and Analysis (ARIA), NASA-JPL/Caltech, Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2022)
